findings.title: PTC Trust Center advisory for CVE-2026-12569 (Windchill / FlexPLM RCE)
findings.summary_md: PTC published its first advisory updates for CVE-2026-12569 on June 17, 2026, noting the critical remote code execution vulnerability in Windchill and FlexPLM and providing initial remediation steps via eSupport article CS473270. The change log records updates at 2:16 PM ET and 9:28 PM ET on June 17, followed by IOC releases and patch availability announcements on June 18.

findings.title: BleepingComputer: Clop ransomware targets Windchill, FlexPLM in data theft attacks
findings.summary_md: The July 24, 2026 report confirms Clop is actively exploiting CVE-2026-12569 to deploy JSP webshells against internet-exposed PTC Windchill and FlexPLM instances for data theft extortion. It cites ReliaQuest observations from the prior day, notes PTC began releasing patches on June 17, and mentions CISA added the flaw to its KEV catalog on June 25.

findings.title: The Hacker News: Cl0p affiliates target internet-exposed PTC Windchill and FlexPLM
findings.summary_md: The July 25, 2026 article describes threat actors linked to Cl0p exploiting a pre-authentication information disclosure in FlexPLM's WSDL endpoint chained with the Windchill RCE (CVE-2026-12569, CVSS 9.3) for unauthenticated remote code execution. It notes deployment of hex-named JSP webshells, references Censys exposure data showing fewer than 100 exposed instances as of June 1, and lists network IOCs including 5.180.41.35.
